A sales clerk and a lawyer were talking about how they ended up in the jobs they did. The sales clerk recalled having a hard time before college, even not passing some classes, and the lawyer started their story talking about having been a member of the honors society back in high school. Who failed classes in high school?
A. The sales clerk
B. Not enough information
C. The lawyer
